If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overconfidence bias.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for pessimism.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 3 days, add 1–2% upward adjustment to late horizon (16–30 days) to capture momentum.  
If sentiment is flat (0.33–0.67) across last 3 days, apply 0.5% downward correction to forecast if true outcome exceeds 1.5% above recent 7-day average.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap upward slope at 0.8% per day to prevent overfitting to bullish sentiment.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, avoid downward corrections beyond 0.5% to prevent amplifying bearish bias.
